text:
alex: Heads-up — aiming to cut the release in ~2h. PRs still in the queue that need quick eyes: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4567 (changes to svc-auth + changelog missing)
release-bot: PR #4567 flagged 'needs-review' by alex
maria: on it, grabbing a quick pass now. will check changelog format and component tag.
kevin: i can do a deeper review after standup (~30m). any flaky tests to note?
alex: unit tests passed, e2e flaked last run — rerunning CI now. also need one more approver for the auth surface changes.
olivia: added 'security' label and pinging sam for approval. @sam can you take a look?
maria: changelog entry is short — needs component set to "platform" and a one-line migration note. i'll push the edit.
kevin: left a comment on TTL handler — tiny nit about nil handling. LGTM after that change.
alex: pushed the nil-check fix, re-ran the tests. CI is green on the latest commit.
olivia: anyone free to approve? blocking the cut. :pray:  
sam: approving now — looked through auth bits, tests seem solid. :thumbsup:
kevin: approving as well. once backports are created we should be good to merge.
alex: created backport PR to release-2026.03: https://github.com/redwood-inference/redwood/pull/4589
release-bot: Backport PR #4589 created successfully
maria: small follow-up — add a migration note in changelog about the new config flag default (so customers know behavior change).
alex: added the migration note and updated the changelog entry. final checklist: changelog updated, backport PR exists, 2 approvals, CI green. anything else?
olivia: no blockers from release side. i'll start the cut procedure in ~5m and notify infra/docs channels.
alex: awesome — thanks everyone :rocket:
